notes.title: Version 1.2.3 & Special promotion - 51% OFF!

tags.feature: - new missions to complete the story;
- New monsters, including the final boss;
- a secret game mode which is extremely hardcore;
- optional auto ammo refill for soldiers;
- ability to order soldiers to hold their fire to save ammo;
- ability to auto switch to another weapon when current weapon is out of ammo;
- extra information panel for breakable objects, soldiers and monsters;
- hotkeys for frequent operations, including map scrolling with arrows and WASD keys;
- save slots and ability to start new game;
- ability to always show soldier placement slots;
